I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and rendering are untested.

It follows `DESIGN.md` and has your content exactly as given.

- **Self-contained:** the tokens I use are copied into the file's own `:root`, so nothing links to `tokens.css`. Every colour, size, spacing and tracking value in the component styles comes from those tokens.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so the file uses the token fallback stacks. In a browser without those fonts it will render in the system font.
- **No page action:** `DESIGN.md` wants one primary button at the top right. I left it out because you asked for exactly this content.
- **Added decoration:** two small additions are not in your content list. Each activity row has a decorative initials avatar (hidden from screen readers), and the Uptime label has a small pink "live" dot.
